rule: Every unit ends with exactly one review node. Chests have chestGems above 0 and no lessons. Skills have 2 to 3 lessons; reviews have 1. Node keys are unique.

cases.name: unit-without-review
cases.expect: unit-3.json › nodes: a unit ends with exactly one review node

cases.name: review-before-the-end
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes: a unit ends with exactly one review node

cases.name: chest-without-gems
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[2]: a chest needs chestGems above 0

cases.name: chest-with-lessons
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[2]: a chest has no lessons

cases.name: skill-with-one-lesson
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0]: needs 2 to 3 lessons, has 1

cases.name: skill-with-four-lessons
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0]: needs 2 to 3 lessons, has 4

cases.name: review-with-two-lessons
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[3]: a review has exactly 1 lesson, has 2

cases.name: skill-with-chest-gems
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0]: only a chest has chestGems, not a skill

cases.name: node-key-used-twice
cases.expect: unit-2.json › nodes[2] › key: 'u1.chest' is already the key of unit-1.json › nodes[2]
